subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@zenhealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call — POC interest

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sam and Priya — really appreciated the candid overview of ZenHealth's priorities. Quick recap from my side and a proposal for next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff: 

Key pain points you called out:
- Too many false positives in clinical triage flows; ops overhead to review suggestions is high.
- Latency spikes during peak hours impacting throughput for chat-based triage.
- Need strict auditability and data retention controls for PHI-related content.

Primary goals for the POC (30-day):
1) Reduce reviewer load by 30% (measured as % of suggestions requiring human override).
2) Maintain or improve triage accuracy (target precision >= 88%).
3) Achieve steady-state 95th percentile latency < 250ms for API responses under your expected burst profile.

Proposed POC scope (high level):
- Ingest a subset of live anonymized triage traffic (10K requests/day) for 4 weeks.
- Deploy Redwood hosted endpoint with model variant tuned for clinical taxonomy.
- Run prompt/eval set (we'll co-develop 200 labeled prompts + gold answers).
- Instrument metrics: precision/recall, reviewer override rate, latency, tokens/cost.

Suggested owners / roles:
- ZenHealth: Sam (eng owner), Priya (PM, success criteria), IT (service account + VPN).
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, project lead), Aditya (solutions engineer, setup + model tuning), Rishi (CS, rollout/ops).

Initial access/setup asks from ZenHealth:
- Create a service account for redwood-poc@zenhealth (read/write logs access).
- Provide SSO metadata (SAML) and networking details if using VPN.
- Sample of 200 labeled prompts and typical payload shapes.

Attachments: I attached a draft POC scope spreadsheet — happy to update and re-issue after your feedback.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sam/Priya: confirm availability for a 30—45m kickoff call next week (we suggested Wed 3/4 @ 10am PT).
- ZenHealth: share service account and SSO metadata, and a short list of 200 evaluation prompts by 3/3.
- Redwood: finalize SOW for signature (DocuSign link to follow) and prepare env for onboarding.

Let me know if I missed anything. I can update the scope and circulate a final kickoff recap once we lock the kickoff time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

----
Attachment: zenhealth-poc-scope-v2.xlsx (POC scope draft)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call — POC interest

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Agree with the goals. For reviewer load reduction, we want to track both % override and mean time to resolve per item.
- We need the POC to explicitly include data retention and audit logs — any solution that touches PHI has to keep an immutable audit trail for 90 days and allow export.
- On performance: our daytime burst profile can hit 2.5k reqs/min for a short window; 95p latency < 250ms is what we'll need to feel comfortable.

I'll attach the security questionnaire — we need Redwood to complete sections on data handling (we can redact where needed). Also, please confirm whether Redwood will use an open-model variant or a Redwood-curated model for the POC; we may prefer an open variant we can vet, but want recommendations.

We can do the kickoff Wed 3/4 at 10am PT. I'll have our infra lead on the call to help provision the service account.

S —
Sam Turner
Director of Engineering, ZenHealth
sam.turner@zenhealth.com

----
Attachment: zenhealth-security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@zenhealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks Sam — great, confirming kickoff Wed 3/4 10:00—10:45am PT. Below is the updated POC kickoff plan (this will be our canonical doc for the workstreams). I added the audit/logging/retention requirements and more detail on metrics and evals.

POC scope (confirmed):
- Window: 30 calendar days from environment readiness.
- Traffic: up to 10K requests/day sampled across triage channels.
- Model: Redwood will suggest two compatible open-weight variants (baseline and tuned); we'll recommend a quantization profile to balance latency/cost. Final model selection during first week of POC.

Success metrics (will instrument from day 1):
- Reviewer override rate: target -30% vs baseline (baseline to be measured during week 1).
- Precision (clinical taxonomy): >= 88% on the labeled eval set (200 prompts).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms at your 2.5k reqs/min burst profile (we'll do load tests).
- Cost proxy: tokens per inference and estimated $/1k requests for chosen config.

Prompt set / evals:
- Redwood to provide seeded prompt set (100) + we need 100 from ZenHealth (total 200).
- We'll run weekly evals and surface regressions via a shared dashboard.

Owners & responsibilities:
- ZenHealth: Sam (eng owner — infra + logs), Priya (PM — evaluation & acceptance), IT (service account + SSO).
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead & CSM touchpoint), Aditya (SE — onboarding, model tuning, load testing), Rishi (CS — rollout guidance), Neha (security/compliance review).

Timeline / milestones (target dates):
- 3/3: ZenHealth to share service account + SSO metadata + 100 eval prompts.
- 3/4: Kickoff call (10:00 PT) — align on SOW and immediate tasks.
- 3/5—3/7: Redwood to provision test endpoint and run initial smoke tests.
- 3/12: Baseline eval and first weekly report delivered.
- 3/26: Final demo & decision meeting.

Access & setup steps (actionable):
1) ZenHealth: create service account redwood-poc@zenhealth and grant read/write logs, and share the credentials via the secure link below.
2) ZenHealth: provide SSO/SAML metadata (attachment) or confirm VPN details if needed.
3) Marissa/Aditya: provision a temporary test key and send example curl snippets + Postman collection.

Attachments included: zenhealth-poc-scope-v2.xlsx, zenhealth-security-questionnaire.pdf, zenhealth-sso-metadata.xml

Doc links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/98765) and shared drive folder for prompts (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c).

DocuSign: SOW will be sent once you confirm scope — link will be in the kickoff follow-up.

Let me know if you'd like any changes to the timeline or owners — otherwise I'll send the calendar invite for Wed 3/4 and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
